name: PCOD, PCOS & Hormonal Imbalance
headline: Balance Hormones Naturally with Ayurveda
intro: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) and Polycystic Ovary Disorder (PCOD) affect millions of women worldwide, leading to irregular periods, infertility, weight gain, acne, and hormonal imbalance. Ayurveda treats PCOD/PCOS by addressing the root cause — hormonal imbalance and metabolic disorders — through personalized therapies, herbal medicines, diet, and lifestyle correction. Unlike conventional treatments, Ayurveda provides long-term relief without side effects.
